caption:
They say the university library is a place of silence, but tonight, it feels like the perfect place for a little rebellion. 🌙✨

The moonlight filters through the high arched windows of the archives, casting long, dramatic shadows over the rows of ancient books. I’m supposed to be grading these thesis papers, but my focus is completely elsewhere. Across the mahogany desk, my student is looking at me with an intensity that makes my heart skip a beat. 

I can feel his gaze lingering on the way my silk blouse fits—it’s a bit more form-fitting than the faculty usually approves of, but it feels perfect tonight. Every time I lean forward to point out a correction, I catch the way his breath hitches. The air between us is thick, heavy with everything we aren't saying out loud. 

I shift slightly in my chair, feeling the subtle weight of the silence. I lean in closer, until the scent of old parchment and his expensive cologne fill my senses. 'You’re missing a very important point here,' I whisper, my voice barely a breath against the quiet of the room. I let my hand linger on the edge of his paper, my fingers grazing his. 

There’s something intoxicating about these stolen moments—the thrill of being caught in a forbidden corner of the campus while the rest of the world sleeps. It’s my favorite secret. Who knew academic life could be this... stimulating? 💋📚
